messages:
cora: Heads-up - customer reported a spike where requests routed through our edge proxy suddenly show billing to a legacy project. Seems like token metadata got rewritten.
ishaan: Noticed similar in canary yesterday. Proxy was upgrading tokens and inadvertently copied an internal project claim.
mei: Do we have an example header trace?
cora: snippet: `Authorization: Bearer sk-edge-xx`, `X-Redwood-Project: ` (empty), proxy adds `X-Token-Meta: project=proj-legacy-07` and routing used that.
jamal: Oof. Proxy should never inject project claims. It was supposed to preserve orig headers only. Could be legacy codepath.
ishaan: Quick fix: reject any token metadata injection from proxies unless header `X-Proxy-Trusted: true` and org admin has explicitly enabled proxy-trust for that org.
mei: I like adding a safety gate. Also emit trace tag `proxy_injected_token_meta=true` and a metric so we can count occurrences.
cora: Support wants a rollback plan: (1) stop proxy token upgrades (2) add FF to ignore proxy-injected project metadata (3) console banner for affected orgs.
jamal: I'll add the FF to routing middleware to ignore `X-Token-Meta.project` and set `billing_bucket=org_unattributed`. We'll keep key-level rate-limits intact.
ishaan: Tests: unit test for header precedence, integ test for proxy chain. Also add a short-lived dataflow to reclassify recent events for finance if needed.
mei: Product will draft the banner copy: "We detected routing metadata injected by a proxy; some usage may be un-attributed. Map traffic or contact support."
ops-bot: [automated] Created ticket INF-5477: "edge-proxy injected token metadata -> ignore by default + telemetry" assigned to jamal/ishaan/mei.
cora: Owners noted. Sync tomorrow 9:30 to review the FF PR and early metrics.
jamal: I'll push a small patch today and dark-launch telemetry.
ishaan: I'll scan historical traces for frequency and share a short report before sync.
cora: Thanks all, closing for now. :thumbsup:
